gates.title: Qt/QNX distribution posture
gates.acceptance: Document the authorized source channel and license determination, exact module/plugin closure, notices and relinking/source obligations where applicable. Evaluation binaries cannot establish this gate.

gates.title: Candidate CI
gates.acceptance: Successful required checks for the release candidate on authorized runners; local checks remain separately labeled.

gates.title: Repeatable graphics cold boot
gates.acceptance: 20 consecutive supervised cold boots on the named release board/image, with recovery and logs. Application relaunch trials do not count as cold boots.

gates.title: Device component and input results
gates.acceptance: Every component has a device disposition and tested limits on stock Pi 4 QSTI; prove keyboard/touch and the selected interaction scope. Pi 400 results stay separate.

gates.title: QNX performance measurements
gates.acceptance: Publish startup-to-first-frame, presented-frame intervals and RSS for Hello World, a 1000-row list and drawer drag, including revision, sample sizes and capture limitations.

gates.title: Clean-host app workflow
gates.acceptance: A new licensed developer can create, build, deploy and run an app from documented prerequisites. Verify actual package ownership and contents before any npm publication.

gates.title: Versioned v1 documentation
gates.acceptance: Published, versioned getting-started, API/support limits, evidence gallery, ADRs and release notes with reviewed local links.
